Regulation: B.C. Reg. 139/2026
Made under: Election Act
Published in: No. 14 – B.C. Regs. 125 to 148, July 28, 2026
Deposit date: July 21, 2026

B.C. Reg. 139/2026, deposited July 21, 2026, under theELECTION ACT[section 283 (1) and (4)]. Regulation of the Chief Electoral Officer, dated July 21, 2026. I, Shipra Verma, Chief Electoral Officer, order that the Ballot Form Regulation, B.C. Reg. 66/2022, is amended as set out in the attached Appendix. — S. VERMA,Chief Electoral Officer. 1	The Ballot Form Regulation, B.C. Reg. 66/2022, is amended (a)	by renumbering section 2 as section 2 (1), (b)	in section 2 by adding the following subsection: (2)	The form of ordinary ballot set out in Schedule 1 may include the following: (a)	information for the purpose of
identifying the voting area; (b)	a quick-response (QR) code for the purposes of verifying the validity of the ballot and identifying the electoral district., and (c)	by repealing Schedule 1 and substituting the attached Schedule 1. minutes_briefs.title: BC ballots can now include QR codes to verify validity and identify the electoral district
minutes_briefs.summary: The BC Chief Electoral Officer amended the Ballot Form Regulation (B.C. Reg. 66/2022) effective July 21, 2026. Ordinary ballots may now include information identifying the voting area and a QR code (a scannable square barcode) used to check that the ballot is valid and to identify the electoral district. Schedule 1, which sets out the ballot form, was replaced.
